subject: Suspicion: coordinated trial credit requests from Mosaic Labs network
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: [ALERT] Multiple trial/top-up patterns: mosaic.ai cluster

Vivek,

Fraud detection flagged a cluster of trial credit requests over the last 72 hours that look coordinated. Quick summary:
- 8 trial/top-up requests tied to domains mosaic.ai and cluster-mosaic.com, coming from different account emails but identical billing IP ranges and overlapping payment metadata.
- Two accounts already consumed >90% of their trial credits within 24 hrs.
- System flagged pattern as HIGH_CONFIDENCE (score: 0.92).

I attached the CSV and the raw API audit slice. Can you advise hold action? This looks like the same org spinning multiple pilot accounts to stack eval credits.

Attachments: mosaic_evidence.csv, api_audit_log_20270728-31.txt

—
Ben Carter
Account Protection | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [ALERT] Multiple trial/top-up patterns: mosaic.ai cluster

Ben —

Thanks for the heads up and the files. Please place an immediate temporary freeze on issuing further trial credits to any new accounts that resolve to mosaic.ai or cluster-mosaic.com while we investigate. Do not retroactively revoke yet — I want the audit preserved.

Marissa, looped in for sales context. Rishi, this may require policy enforcement / credits reclamation — can you take the lead on legal/compliance implications?

Vivek
VP, Trust & Reliability
Redwood Inference

Vivek / Ben —

Context from the commercial side: we have an ongoing pilot with Mosaic Labs (primary contact Mike Chen) for a multi-team evaluation. They requested separate workspaces for three different product teams; sales approved separate trial seats because they claimed independent billing.

That said, the account structure looked odd: two of the emails were disposable-style, and the HubSpot records show the same parent org and PO number. I'm attaching the HubSpot deal and the link to the contacts for your review.

My recommendation: hold new trial grants and ask Mosaic for a short self-attestation confirming unique billing per team. If they can't provide it, we should consolidate the pilots under one contract or revoke overlapping credits.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: [ALERT] Multiple trial/top-up patterns: mosaic.ai cluster

Team —

I reviewed the attached audit slice and ran a quick mapping against our known abuse signals. Observations:
- Shared IP pools and near-identical user-agent strings across accounts.
- Two accounts used the same corporate credit card tokenized in our system (different email on file).
- Rapid consumption of credits in sub-24-hour windows is a strong abuse indicator.

Given the evidence, I recommend:
1) Immediate suspension of new trial grants for mosaic.ai/cluster-mosaic.com (Ben, done per Vivek).
2) Prepare a credits-reclamation plan for accounts that consumed >50% of granted trial credits in <48 hours. We should coordinate with Finance on potential pro-rata billing or clawback.
3) Legal to draft a short notice to Mosaic asking for evidence of separate entities/POs; if they can't produce it within 5 business days, proceed with consolidation and credit reversal.

I'll open a compliance ticket and tag Legal. Ben — preserve logs and DO NOT purge any data until we get legal sign-off.

Rishi Malhotra
Head, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Mike Chen <mike@mosaic.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Suspicion: coordinated trial credit requests from Mosaic Labs network

Marissa / Vivek —

Thanks for flagging. I'm surprised to hear about coordinated activity — Mosaic is a single company but we have multiple business units who run independent procurement and engineering pilots. Each team requested separate workspaces because their teams are isolated for security and billing reasons.

If the issue is tokenization or shared IP, happy to have our infra team provide an attestation and a company letter confirming separate org units. We can also provide purchase orders for each team; it will take us a day to assemble. Please let me know exactly what you need so we can avoid disruption to our pilots.

—
Mike Chen
Head of Platform | Mosaic Labs
mike@mosaic.ai
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Action: Mosaic Labs trial credits — freeze + next steps

Team,

Decision summary after reviewing evidence and Mike's note:
- Maintain immediate freeze on new trial/top-up grants tied to mosaic.ai and cluster-mosaic.com pending Mosaic's response.
- Issue a formal request to Mosaic (Mike) asking for:
  * Company letter confirming separate legal entities or independent POs for each pilot team
  * Tokenized payment evidence showing distinct payment instruments per entity
  * Network/infra attestation if they expect shared IP ranges
- Give Mosaic 5 business days to produce documentation. If they fail, we will:
  * Consolidate pilots under the primary Mosaic account and revoke overlapping trial credits (Finance to prepare prorated invoicing or clawback).
  * Flag accounts for 90-day hold on trial eligibility.
- Ben: keep full audit logs and snapshot DB rows related to the accounts; don't rotate tokens or purge data.
- Marissa: coordinate a customer-friendly notice and offer a discount to move to a consolidated Dedicated trial if they commit to a single PO.
- Rishi: open INFRA ticket and copy Legal; prepare template notice and credit-reclaim wording.

I'll draft the notice and share the JIRA ticket. This is an important precedent — we'll update the trial policy after resolution.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Trust & Reliability
Redwood Inference
